class Document(string kind, value := "", flat_value := "", amount := 0, int[] children := [])
class Store(Document[] items := [])

int add(Store &store, const Document document)
    index := int(#store.items)
    store.items = store.items.append(document)
    return index

int text(Store &store, string value)
    return add(&store, Document("text", value))

void flatten(const Store store, int index, int[] &result, Store &destination)
    document := store.items[index]
    if document.kind == "concat"
        for child := document.children[]
            flatten(store, child, &result, &destination)
    elif document.kind == "text"
        if document.value == ""
            return
        if #result > 0 and destination.items[result[-1]].kind == "text"
            previous := result[-1]
            combined := destination.items[previous].value + document.value
            result[-1] = text(&destination, combined)
        else
            result = result.append(index)
    else
        result = result.append(index)

int concat(Store &store, const int[] parts)
    int[] result := []
    snapshot := store
    for part := parts[]
        flatten(snapshot, part, &result, &store)
    if #result == 0
        return text(&store, "")
    if #result == 1
        return result[0]
    return add(&store, Document("concat", children = result))

int group(Store &store, int child)
    return add(&store, Document("group", children = [child]))

int nest(Store &store, int amount, int child)
    return add(&store, Document("nest", amount = amount, children = [child]))

int align(Store &store, int child)
    return add(&store, Document("align", children = [child]))

int line(Store &store)
    return add(&store, Document("line"))

int softline(Store &store)
    return add(&store, Document("softline"))

int hardline(Store &store)
    return add(&store, Document("hardline"))

int break_parent(Store &store)
    return add(&store, Document("break_parent"))

int suffix(Store &store, string value)
    return add(&store, Document("suffix", value))

int if_break(Store &store, string broken, string flat)
    return add(&store, Document("if_break", broken, flat))

bool forced(const Store store, int index)
    document := store.items[index]
    if document.kind == "hardline" or document.kind == "break_parent"
        return true
    for child := document.children[]
        if forced(store, child)
            return true
    return false

int group_count(const Store store, int index)
    document := store.items[index]
    result := if document.kind == "group" then 1 else 0
    for child := document.children[]
        result += group_count(store, child)
    return result

class Problem(int line, int column, string reason)
class Comment(string text, int line, int column, int blank, bool line_comment, own := false)
class Token(string text, string kind, int line, int column, int blank, Comment[] leading := [], Comment[] trailing := [])
class Occurrence(bool token, int index)
class Lexed(Token[] tokens := [], Comment[] comments := [], Occurrence[] order := [])

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

string repeat(string text, int count)
    result := ""
    for: iteration < count
        result += text
    return result

string trim_end(string text)
    finish := int(#text)
    while finish > 0 and text[finish - 1] == " "
        finish -= 1
    return text[0:<finish]

bool letter(string character)
    return (character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122)

bool digit(string character)
    return character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

Lexed | Problem lex(const string[] lines)
    result := Lexed()
    previous := 0
    for: row < int(#lines)
        line := lines[row]
        position := 0
        while position < int(#line)
            if line[position] == " "
                position += 1
                continue
            start := position
            line_number := row + 1
            blank := maximum(0, line_number - previous - 1)
            remaining := line[position:<int(#line)]
            if remaining.starts_with("//")
                result.order = result.order.append(Occurrence(false, int(#result.comments)))
                result.comments = result.comments.append(Comment(trim_end(remaining), line_number, position + 1, blank, true))
                previous = line_number
                break
            if remaining.starts_with("/*")
                finish := position + 2
                while finish + 1 < int(#line) and line[finish:<finish + 2] != "*/"
                    finish += 1
                if finish + 1 >= int(#line)
                    return Problem(line_number, start + 1, "unterminated comment")
                result.order = result.order.append(Occurrence(false, int(#result.comments)))
                result.comments = result.comments.append(Comment(line[position:<finish + 2], line_number, position + 1, blank, false))
                previous = line_number
                position = finish + 2
                continue
            kind := ""
            character := line[position]
            if letter(character) or character == "_"
                position += 1
                while position < int(#line) and (letter(line[position]) or digit(line[position]) or line[position] == "_")
                    position += 1
                word := line[start:<position]
                kind = if has(["int", "float", "bool", "string", "void", "if", "else", "while", "for", "return", "break", "continue", "true", "false", "switch", "case", "default"], word) then "keyword" else "identifier"
            elif digit(character)
                position += 1
                while position < int(#line) and digit(line[position])
                    position += 1
                if position + 1 < int(#line) and line[position] == "." and digit(line[position + 1])
                    position += 2
                    while position < int(#line) and digit(line[position])
                        position += 1
                kind = "number"
            elif character == DQ
                position += 1
                closed := false
                while position < int(#line)
                    if line[position] == "\"
                        position += 2
                    elif line[position] == DQ
                        position += 1
                        closed = true
                        break
                    else
                        position += 1
                if not closed
                    return Problem(line_number, start + 1, "unterminated string")
                kind = "string"
            elif position + 1 < int(#line) and has(["<=", ">=", "==", "!=", "&&", "||", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%="], line[position:<position + 2])
                position += 2
                kind = "symbol"
            elif "+-*/%<>=!()[]{{}},;.?:".contains(character)
                position += 1
                kind = "symbol"
            else
                return Problem(line_number, start + 1, "unexpected character '{character}'")
            result.order = result.order.append(Occurrence(true, int(#result.tokens)))
            result.tokens = result.tokens.append(Token(line[start:<position], kind, line_number, start + 1, blank))
            previous = line_number
    result.tokens = result.tokens.append(Token("", "end", int(#lines) + 1, 1, 0))
    return result

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"
import doc = "./doc_builder.qui"
import printer = "./printer.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

class Profile(values := map<string, string>())
    string value(string key)
        match values.get(key)
            string found
                return found
            none
                return ""

    bool yes(string key)
        return value(key) == "yes"

    int number(string key)
        parsed := int(value(key))
        return parsed

    bool kr()
        return value("brace_style") == "kr"

class Construction(lexer.Token[] tokens, parser.Node[] nodes, Profile style, bool[] original_trailing, documents := doc.Store())
class Closing(lexer.Comment[] own, lexer.Comment[] inline)
class Entry(int operator_token, int right)
class FirstFunction(string name, int document)
class Formatted(string[] lines, doc.Store documents, FirstFunction | none first_function, map<int, string> modes, int comments, int groups)
class Source(string header, string name, string profile, string[] lines := [])
class Inputs(map<string, Profile> profiles, Source[] sources)

lexer.Token[] attach(const lexer.Lexed lexed)
    lexer.Token[] tokens := lexed.tokens
    for: position < int(#lexed.order)
        lexer.Occurrence entry := lexed.order[position]
        if entry.token
            continue
        lexer.Comment comment := lexed.comments[entry.index]
        previous := -1
        following := -1
        cursor := position - 1
        while cursor >= 0
            if lexed.order[cursor].token
                previous = lexed.order[cursor].index
                break
            cursor -= 1
        cursor = position + 1
        while cursor < int(#lexed.order)
            if lexed.order[cursor].token
                following = lexed.order[cursor].index
                break
            cursor += 1
        next_line := -1
        if position + 1 < int(#lexed.order)
            lexer.Occurrence next := lexed.order[position + 1]
            next_line = if next.token then tokens[next.index].line else lexed.comments[next.index].line
        comment.own = comment.line_comment or next_line < 0 or next_line > comment.line
        trailing := previous >= 0 and tokens[previous].line == comment.line and (following < 0 or tokens[following].line > comment.line)
        if trailing
            tokens[previous].trailing = tokens[previous].trailing.append(comment)
        else
            target := if following < 0 then int(#tokens) - 1 else following
            tokens[target].leading = tokens[target].leading.append(comment)
    return tokens

void allow_comments(const parser.Node[] nodes, int index, bool[] &allowed, bool[] &tails)
    node := nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "block"
        allowed[node.tokens[1]] = true
        for child := node.children[]
            allowed[nodes[child].start] = true
    elif node.kind == "switch"
        allowed[node.tokens[4]] = true
        for: 1 <= position < int(#node.children)
            clause := nodes[node.children[position]]
            allowed[clause.tokens[0]] = true
            first := if clause.kind == "case" then 1 else 0
            for: first <= child_index < int(#clause.children)
                allowed[nodes[clause.children[child_index]].start] = true
    elif node.kind == "if" or node.kind == "while"
        body := nodes[node.children[1]]
        if body.kind != "block"
            allowed[body.start] = true
        if node.kind == "if" and #node.children == 3
            alternative := nodes[node.children[2]]
            if alternative.kind != "block" and alternative.kind != "if"
                allowed[alternative.start] = true
    elif node.kind == "for"
        body := nodes[node.children[3]]
        if body.kind != "block"
            allowed[body.start] = true
    elif lexer.has(["params", "args", "initlist"], node.kind)
        for child := node.children[]
            allowed[nodes[child].start] = true
        match node.trailing
            int token
                tails[token] = true
            none
                tails = tails
    for child := node.children[]
        allow_comments(nodes, child, &allowed, &tails)

lexer.Problem | none check_comments(const parser.Program program, const lexer.Token[] tokens)
    allowed := array(#tokens, fill = false)
    tails := allowed
    allowed[-1] = true
    for item := program.items[]
        allowed[program.nodes[item].start] = true
        allow_comments(program.nodes, item, &allowed, &tails)
    for: position < int(#tokens)
        for comment := tokens[position].leading[]
            if (comment.own and not allowed[position]) or tails[position]
                return lexer.Problem(comment.line, comment.column, "comment not allowed here")
    return none

int text_document(Construction &context, string value)
    return doc.text(&context.documents, value)

int combine(Construction &context, const int[] parts)
    return doc.concat(&context.documents, parts)

int line_document(Construction &context, string kind)
    return doc.add(&context.documents, doc.Document(kind))

int nest_document(Construction &context, int amount, int child)
    return doc.nest(&context.documents, amount, child)

int group_document(Construction &context, int child)
    return doc.group(&context.documents, child)

int space_document(Construction &context)
    return text_document(&context, if context.style.yes("space_around_operators") then " " else "")

int keyword_space(Construction &context)
    return text_document(&context, if context.style.yes("space_after_keyword") then " " else "")

int operator_line(Construction &context)
    return line_document(&context, if context.style.yes("space_around_operators") then "line" else "softline")

int separator(Construction &context, int blank)
    int[] parts := []
    for: iteration < 1 + lexer.minimum(blank, context.style.number("max_blank_lines"))
        parts = parts.append(line_document(&context, "hardline"))
    return combine(&context, parts)

int preblank(const Construction context, int token)
    return if #context.tokens[token].leading > 0 then context.tokens[token].leading[0].blank else context.tokens[token].blank

int comment_document(Construction &context, const lexer.Comment[] comments, const int | none next_blank)
    int[] parts := []
    for: position < int(#comments)
        comment := comments[position]
        parts = parts.append(text_document(&context, comment.text))
        int | none blank := next_blank
        if position + 1 < int(#comments)
            blank = comments[position + 1].blank
        match blank
            int found
                parts = parts.append(if comment.own then separator(&context, found) else text_document(&context, " "))
            none
                parts = parts
    return combine(&context, parts)

int trailing_document(Construction &context, int token)
    string[] comments := []
    for comment := context.tokens[token].trailing[]
        comments = comments.append(comment.text)
    if #comments == 0
        return text_document(&context, "")
    return doc.suffix(&context.documents, comments.join(" "))

int token_with(Construction &context, int token, const lexer.Comment[] leading)
    before := comment_document(&context, leading, context.tokens[token].blank)
    value := text_document(&context, context.tokens[token].text)
    after := trailing_document(&context, token)
    return combine(&context, [before, value, after])

int token_document(Construction &context, int token)
    lexer.Comment[] leading := context.tokens[token].leading
    return token_with(&context, token, leading)

int level(const Construction context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    return if node.kind == "conditional" then 0 elif node.kind == "binary" then parser.precedence(context.tokens[node.tokens[0]].text) elif node.kind == "unary" then 7 else 8

int open_expression(Construction &context, int original, int required)
    current := original
    while context.style.yes("remove_parens")
        node := context.nodes[current]
        if node.kind != "paren" or level(context, node.children[0]) < required or #context.tokens[node.tokens[0]].leading > 0 or #context.tokens[node.tokens[1]].leading > 0
            break
        child := node.children[0]
        inner := context.nodes[child]
        lexer.Comment[] first := context.tokens[node.tokens[0]].trailing
        lexer.Comment[] last := context.tokens[node.tokens[1]].trailing
        context.tokens[node.tokens[0]].trailing = []
        context.tokens[node.tokens[1]].trailing = []
        context.tokens[inner.start].trailing = first.concat(context.tokens[inner.start].trailing)
        context.tokens[inner.finish].trailing = context.tokens[inner.finish].trailing.concat(last)
        current = child
    return current

int expression_document(Construction &context, int original, int required);
int statement_document(Construction &context, int index);
int list_document(Construction &context, int index);

int parameter_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    space := text_document(&context, " ")
    second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
    parts := [first, space, second]
    for child := node.children[]
        dimension := context.nodes[child]
        parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, dimension.tokens[0]))
        parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, dimension.tokens[1]))
    return combine(&context, parts)

int initializer_document(Construction &context, int index)
    return if context.nodes[index].kind == "initlist" then list_document(&context, index) else expression_document(&context, index, 0)

int list_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    left := node.tokens[0]
    right := node.tokens[-1]
    if #node.children == 0
        opening := token_document(&context, left)
        closing := token_document(&context, right)
        return combine(&context, [opening, closing])
    forced := false
    for: node.start <= token < node.finish
        if context.original_trailing[token]
            forced = true
    inside := [line_document(&context, "softline")]
    for: position < int(#node.children)
        if position > 0
            inside = inside.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[position]))
            inside = inside.append(line_document(&context, "line"))
        child := node.children[position]
        built := if node.kind == "params" then parameter_document(&context, child) elif node.kind == "initlist" then initializer_document(&context, child) else expression_document(&context, child, 0)
        inside = inside.append(built)
    if node.kind == "initlist"
        inside = inside.append(doc.if_break(&context.documents, ",", ""))
        match node.trailing
            int token
                inside = inside.append(trailing_document(&context, token))
            none
                inside = inside
    marker := if forced then line_document(&context, "break_parent") else text_document(&context, "")
    opening := token_document(&context, left)
    nested_contents := combine(&context, inside)
    nested := nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), nested_contents)
    soft := line_document(&context, "softline")
    closing := token_document(&context, right)
    contents := combine(&context, [marker, opening, nested, soft, closing])
    return group_document(&context, contents)

int declaration_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    space := text_document(&context, " ")
    second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
    parts := [first, space, second]
    initial := -1
    for child := node.children[]
        child_node := context.nodes[child]
        if child_node.kind == "dimension"
            parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, child_node.tokens[0]))
            if #child_node.children > 0
                parts = parts.append(expression_document(&context, child_node.children[0], 0))
            parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, child_node.tokens[1]))
        else
            initial = child
    for: 2 <= position < int(#node.tokens)
        token := node.tokens[position]
        if context.tokens[token].text == "="
            parts = parts.append(space_document(&context))
            parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, token))
            parts = parts.append(space_document(&context))
            parts = parts.append(initializer_document(&context, initial))
        else
            parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, token))
    return combine(&context, parts)

Closing closing_comments(const Construction context, int token)
    lexer.Comment[] comments := context.tokens[token].leading
    split := 0
    for: position < int(#comments)
        if comments[position].own
            split = position + 1
    return Closing(comments[0:<split], comments[split:<int(#comments)])

int block_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    close := node.tokens[1]
    comments := closing_comments(context, close)
    opening := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    if #node.children == 0 and #comments.own == 0
        closing := token_with(&context, close, comments.inline)
        return combine(&context, [opening, closing])
    inside := [line_document(&context, "hardline")]
    for: position < int(#node.children)
        child := node.children[position]
        if position > 0
            inside = inside.append(separator(&context, preblank(context, context.nodes[child].start)))
        inside = inside.append(statement_document(&context, child))
    if #comments.own > 0
        if #node.children > 0
            inside = inside.append(separator(&context, comments.own[0].blank))
        inside = inside.append(comment_document(&context, comments.own, none))
    contents := combine(&context, inside)
    nested := nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents)
    hard := line_document(&context, "hardline")
    closing := token_with(&context, close, comments.inline)
    return combine(&context, [opening, nested, hard, closing])

int body_document(Construction &context, int index)
    boundary := if context.style.kr() then text_document(&context, " ") else line_document(&context, "hardline")
    if context.nodes[index].kind == "block"
        body := block_document(&context, index)
        return combine(&context, [boundary, body])
    body := statement_document(&context, index)
    hard := line_document(&context, "hardline")
    contents := combine(&context, [hard, body])
    nested := nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents)
    if context.style.yes("add_braces")
        opening := text_document(&context, "{{")
        closing_line := line_document(&context, "hardline")
        closing := text_document(&context, "}}")
        return combine(&context, [boundary, opening, nested, closing_line, closing])
    return nested

int simple_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    first := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0)
    if node.kind != "assign"
        return first
    left_space := space_document(&context)
    operator_token := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    right_space := space_document(&context)
    second := expression_document(&context, node.children[1], 0)
    return combine(&context, [first, left_space, operator_token, right_space, second])

int clause_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    parts := [token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])]
    first := if node.kind == "case" then 1 else 0
    if first == 1
        parts = parts.append(text_document(&context, " "))
        parts = parts.append(expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0))
    parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[1]))
    if int(#node.children) > first
        statements := [line_document(&context, "hardline")]
        for: first <= position < int(#node.children)
            child := node.children[position]
            if position > first
                statements = statements.append(separator(&context, preblank(context, context.nodes[child].start)))
            statements = statements.append(statement_document(&context, child))
        contents := combine(&context, statements)
        parts = parts.append(nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents))
    return combine(&context, parts)

int statement_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "block"
        return block_document(&context, index)
    if node.kind == "decl"
        return declaration_document(&context, index)
    if node.kind == "statement"
        value := simple_document(&context, node.children[0])
        ending := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        return combine(&context, [value, ending])
    if node.kind == "break" or node.kind == "continue"
        first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
        return combine(&context, [first, second])
    if node.kind == "return"
        parts := [token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])]
        if #node.children > 0
            parts = parts.append(text_document(&context, " "))
            parts = parts.append(expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0))
        parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[1]))
        return combine(&context, parts)
    if node.kind == "while" or node.kind == "if"
        keyword := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        space := keyword_space(&context)
        opening := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
        condition := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0)
        closing := token_document(&context, node.tokens[2])
        body := body_document(&context, node.children[1])
        parts := [keyword, space, opening, condition, closing, body]
        if node.kind == "if" and #node.children == 3
            same_line := context.style.kr() and (context.nodes[node.children[1]].kind == "block" or context.style.yes("add_braces"))
            parts = parts.append(if same_line then text_document(&context, " ") else line_document(&context, "hardline"))
            parts = parts.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[3]))
            if context.nodes[node.children[2]].kind == "if"
                parts = parts.append(text_document(&context, " "))
                parts = parts.append(statement_document(&context, node.children[2]))
            else
                parts = parts.append(body_document(&context, node.children[2]))
        return combine(&context, parts)
    if node.kind == "for"
        keyword := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        space := keyword_space(&context)
        opening := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
        int[] inside := []
        initial := node.children[0]
        initial_kind := context.nodes[initial].kind
        if initial_kind != "empty"
            inside = inside.append(if initial_kind == "decl" then declaration_document(&context, initial) else simple_document(&context, initial))
        inside = inside.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[2]))
        if context.nodes[node.children[1]].kind != "empty"
            inside = inside.append(line_document(&context, "line"))
            inside = inside.append(expression_document(&context, node.children[1], 0))
        inside = inside.append(token_document(&context, node.tokens[3]))
        if context.nodes[node.children[2]].kind != "empty"
            inside = inside.append(line_document(&context, "line"))
            inside = inside.append(simple_document(&context, node.children[2]))
        contents := combine(&context, inside)
        aligned := doc.align(&context.documents, contents)
        grouped := group_document(&context, aligned)
        closing := token_document(&context, node.tokens[4])
        body := body_document(&context, node.children[3])
        return combine(&context, [keyword, space, opening, grouped, closing, body])
    close := node.tokens[4]
    comments := closing_comments(context, close)
    keyword := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    space := keyword_space(&context)
    opening := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
    condition := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0)
    closing_parenthesis := token_document(&context, node.tokens[2])
    boundary := if context.style.kr() then text_document(&context, " ") else line_document(&context, "hardline")
    opening_brace := token_document(&context, node.tokens[3])
    parts := [keyword, space, opening, condition, closing_parenthesis, boundary, opening_brace]
    if #node.children > 1 or #comments.own > 0
        inside := [line_document(&context, "hardline")]
        for: 1 <= position < int(#node.children)
            child := node.children[position]
            if position > 1
                inside = inside.append(separator(&context, preblank(context, context.nodes[child].start)))
            inside = inside.append(clause_document(&context, child))
        if #comments.own > 0
            if #node.children > 1
                inside = inside.append(separator(&context, comments.own[0].blank))
            inside = inside.append(comment_document(&context, comments.own, none))
        contents := combine(&context, inside)
        amount := if context.style.yes("indent_case_labels") then context.style.number("indent") else 0
        parts = parts.append(nest_document(&context, amount, contents))
        parts = parts.append(line_document(&context, "hardline"))
    parts = parts.append(token_with(&context, close, comments.inline))
    return combine(&context, parts)

int function_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    space := text_document(&context, " ")
    second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
    parameters := list_document(&context, node.children[0])
    hard := line_document(&context, "hardline")
    body := block_document(&context, node.children[1])
    return combine(&context, [first, space, second, parameters, hard, body])

int postfix_document(Construction &context, int index)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "call"
        return list_document(&context, node.children[1])
    first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    if node.kind == "index"
        value := expression_document(&context, node.children[1], 0)
        second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
        return combine(&context, [first, value, second])
    second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
    return combine(&context, [first, second])

int expression_document(Construction &context, int original, int required)
    index := open_expression(&context, original, required)
    node := context.nodes[index]
    if node.kind == "atom"
        return token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
    if node.kind == "paren"
        first := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        value := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 0)
        second := token_document(&context, node.tokens[1])
        return combine(&context, [first, value, second])
    if node.kind == "unary"
        operator_token := token_document(&context, node.tokens[0])
        operand := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 8)
        return combine(&context, [operator_token, operand])
    if node.kind == "binary"
        priority := level(context, index)
        current := index
        Entry[] entries := []
        while context.nodes[current].kind == "binary" and level(context, current) == priority
            current_node := context.nodes[current]
            entries = entries.append(Entry(current_node.tokens[0], current_node.children[1]))
            current = open_expression(&context, current_node.children[0], priority)
        head := expression_document(&context, current, priority)
        int[] rest := []
        backwards := entries[::-1]
        for entry := backwards[]
            rest = rest.append(operator_line(&context))
            rest = rest.append(token_document(&context, entry.operator_token))
            rest = rest.append(space_document(&context))
            rest = rest.append(expression_document(&context, entry.right, priority + 1))
        contents := combine(&context, rest)
        nested := nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents)
        full := combine(&context, [head, nested])
        return group_document(&context, full)
    if node.kind == "conditional"
        head := expression_document(&context, node.children[0], 1)
        current := index
        int[] rest := []
        while true
            current_node := context.nodes[current]
            rest = rest.append(operator_line(&context))
            rest = rest.append(token_document(&context, current_node.tokens[0]))
            rest = rest.append(space_document(&context))
            rest = rest.append(expression_document(&context, current_node.children[1], 0))
            rest = rest.append(operator_line(&context))
            rest = rest.append(token_document(&context, current_node.tokens[1]))
            rest = rest.append(space_document(&context))
            next := open_expression(&context, current_node.children[2], 0)
            if context.nodes[next].kind == "conditional"
                rest = rest.append(expression_document(&context, context.nodes[next].children[0], 1))
                current = next
            else
                rest = rest.append(expression_document(&context, next, 0))
                break
        contents := combine(&context, rest)
        nested := nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents)
        full := combine(&context, [head, nested])
        return group_document(&context, full)
    current := index
    int[] operations := []
    while lexer.has(["call", "index", "member"], context.nodes[current].kind)
        operations = operations.append(current)
        current = open_expression(&context, context.nodes[current].children[0], 8)
    int[][] segments := [[]]
    backwards := operations[::-1]
    for operation := backwards[]
        if context.nodes[operation].kind == "member"
            segments = segments.append([])
        last := int(#segments) - 1
        segments[last] = segments[last].append(operation)
    int[] calls := []
    for: 1 <= position < int(#segments)
        contains_call := false
        for operation := segments[position][]
            if context.nodes[operation].kind == "call"
                contains_call = true
        if contains_call
            calls = calls.append(position)
    parts := [expression_document(&context, current, 8)]
    if #calls < 2
        for segment := segments[]
            for operation := segment[]
                parts = parts.append(postfix_document(&context, operation))
        return combine(&context, parts)
    first := calls[0]
    for: position < first
        for operation := segments[position][]
            parts = parts.append(postfix_document(&context, operation))
    int[] rest := []
    for: first <= position < int(#segments)
        rest = rest.append(line_document(&context, "softline"))
        for operation := segments[position][]
            rest = rest.append(postfix_document(&context, operation))
    contents := combine(&context, rest)
    parts = parts.append(nest_document(&context, context.style.number("indent"), contents))
    full := combine(&context, parts)
    return group_document(&context, full)

Formatted | lexer.Problem format_source(const string[] lines, const Profile style)
    lexer.Lexed lexed
    match lexer.lex(lines)
        lexer.Lexed found
            lexed = found
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
    tokens := attach(lexed)
    parser.Program program
    match parser.parse(tokens)
        parser.Program found
            program = found
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
    match check_comments(program, tokens)
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            tokens = tokens
    bool[] original_trailing := []
    for token := tokens[]
        original_trailing = original_trailing.append(#token.trailing > 0)
    context := Construction(tokens, program.nodes, style, original_trailing)
    int[] parts := []
    FirstFunction | none first_function := none
    for: position < int(#program.items)
        index := program.items[position]
        parser.Node item := program.nodes[index]
        if position > 0
            parts = parts.append(separator(&context, preblank(context, item.start)))
        document := if item.kind == "function" then function_document(&context, index) else declaration_document(&context, index)
        if item.kind == "function"
            FirstFunction | none next_first_function := first_function
            match first_function
                FirstFunction previous
                    void
                none
                    next_first_function = FirstFunction(context.tokens[item.tokens[1]].text, document)
            first_function = next_first_function
        parts = parts.append(document)
    lexer.Comment[] closing := context.tokens[-1].leading
    if #closing > 0
        if #program.items > 0
            parts = parts.append(separator(&context, closing[0].blank))
        parts = parts.append(comment_document(&context, closing, none))
    if #program.items == 0 and #closing == 0
        return Formatted([], context.documents, first_function, map<int, string>(), int(#lexed.comments), 0)
    whole := combine(&context, parts)
    printed := printer.render(context.documents, whole, style.number("width"), style.number("comment_column"))
    return Formatted(printed.lines, context.documents, first_function, printed.modes, int(#lexed.comments), doc.group_count(context.documents, whole))

Inputs inputs()
    map<string, Profile> profiles
    current := ""
    current_profile := Profile()
    string settings_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/style.txt"))
    style_lines := settings_text.split(NL)
    for line := style_lines[]
        if line == ""
            continue
        if line.starts_with("[")
            if current != ""
                .profiles.set(current, current_profile)
            current = line[1:<int(#line) - 1]
            current_profile = Profile()
        else
            pair := line.split("=")
            .current_profile.values.set(pair[0], pair[1])
    if current != ""
        .profiles.set(current, current_profile)
    Source[] sources := []
    string source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/sources.txt"))
    source_lines := source_text.split(NL)
    for: position < int(#source_lines) - 1
        line := source_lines[position]
        if line.starts_with("=== ")
            parts := line.split(" ")
            sources = sources.append(Source(line, parts[1], parts[2]))
        else
            last := int(#sources) - 1
            sources[last].lines = sources[last].lines.append(line)
    return Inputs(profiles, sources)

Profile | error required_profile(const map<string, Profile> profiles, string name)
    match profiles.get(name)
        Profile found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing profile")

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    data := inputs()
    string[] formatted := []
    string[] idempotency := []
    string[] diagnostics := []
    string[] document_tree := []
    string[] changes := []
    for source := data.sources[]
        style := required_profile(data.profiles, source.profile)
        string[] original := []
        for line := source.lines[]
            original = original.append(lexer.trim_end(line))
        formatted = formatted.append(source.header)
        document_tree = document_tree.append("=== {source.name}")
        changes = changes.append("=== {source.name}")
        match format_source(source.lines, style)
            lexer.Problem problem
                formatted = formatted.concat(original)
                idempotency = idempotency.append("{source.name}: skipped (syntax error)")
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("{source.name}:{problem.line}:{problem.column}: error: {problem.reason}")
                document_tree = document_tree.append("syntax error")
                changes = changes.append("skipped (syntax error)")
            Formatted first
                formatted = formatted.concat(first.lines)
                match format_source(first.lines, style)
                    lexer.Problem problem
                        idempotency = idempotency.append("{source.name}: unstable (second pass: {problem.line}:{problem.column}: {problem.reason})")
                    Formatted second
                        if first.lines == second.lines
                            idempotency = idempotency.append("{source.name}: stable")
                        else
                            count := lexer.minimum(int(#first.lines), int(#second.lines))
                            differing := count
                            for: position < count
                                if first.lines[position] != second.lines[position]
                                    differing = position
                                    break
                            idempotency = idempotency.append("{source.name}: unstable at line {differing + 1}")
                width := style.number("width")
                longest := 0
                for: position < int(#first.lines)
                    length := int(#first.lines[position])
                    longest = lexer.maximum(longest, length)
                    if length > width
                        diagnostics = diagnostics.append("{source.name}:{position + 1}: warning: line too long ({length} > {width})")
                broken := 0
                forced := 0
                modes := first.modes.values()
                for mode := modes[]
                    if mode != "flat"
                        broken += 1
                    if mode == "forced"
                        forced += 1
                document_tree = document_tree.append("metrics lines={#first.lines} longest={longest} comments={first.comments} groups={first.groups} broken={broken} forced={forced}")
                match first.first_function
                    FirstFunction function
                        document_tree = document_tree.append("function {function.name}")
                        report.tree(first.documents, function.document, 0, first.modes, &document_tree)
                    none
                        document_tree = document_tree.append("no function")
                changes = changes.concat(report.diff(original, first.lines))
    if #diagnostics == 0
        diagnostics = ["no diagnostics"]
    write_output("formatted.txt", formatted)
    write_output("idempotency.txt", idempotency)
    write_output("diagnostics.txt", diagnostics)
    write_output("doc_tree.txt", document_tree)
    write_output("changes.txt", changes)

if main
    run_program()

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class Node(string kind, int[] tokens, int[] children, int start, int finish, int | none trailing := none)
class Program(Node[] nodes, int[] items)
class Parsing(lexer.Token[] tokens, position := 0, Node[] nodes := [], lexer.Problem | none problem := none)

bool is_type(string text)
    return lexer.has(["int", "float", "bool", "string", "void"], text)

int precedence(string text)
    return if text == "||" then 1 elif text == "&&" then 2 elif text == "==" or text == "!=" then 3 elif lexer.has(["<", "<=", ">", ">="], text) then 4 elif text == "+" or text == "-" then 5 elif lexer.has(["*", "/", "%"], text) then 6 else 0

bool failed(const Parsing context)
    match context.problem
        lexer.Problem found
            return true
        none
            return false

lexer.Token peek(const Parsing context)
    return context.tokens[context.position]

string next_text(const Parsing context)
    return peek(context).text

int take(Parsing &context)
    index := context.position
    if peek(context).kind != "end"
        context.position += 1
    return index

int failure(Parsing &context, string expected)
    token := peek(context)
    actual := if token.kind == "end" then "end of file" else "'{token.text}'"
    if not failed(context)
        context.problem = lexer.Problem(token.line, token.column, "expected {expected}, found {actual}")
    return context.position

int symbol(Parsing &context, string value)
    if next_text(context) != value
        return failure(&context, "'{value}'")
    return take(&context)

int identifier(Parsing &context)
    if peek(context).kind != "identifier"
        return failure(&context, "identifier")
    return take(&context)

int read_type(Parsing &context)
    if not is_type(next_text(context))
        return failure(&context, "type")
    return take(&context)

int node(Parsing &context, string kind, const int[] tokens, const int[] children, int start, const int | none trailing := none)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.nodes)
    context.nodes = context.nodes.append(Node(kind, tokens, children, start, lexer.maximum(0, context.position - 1), trailing))
    return index

int empty_node(Parsing &context)
    return node(&context, "empty", [], [], context.position)

int expression(Parsing &context);
int statement(Parsing &context);
int initializer(Parsing &context);
int declaration_rest(Parsing &context, int start, const int[] original, bool semicolon);
int unary(Parsing &context);

int list_element(Parsing &context, string kind)
    if kind == "params"
        start := context.position
        type_token := read_type(&context)
        name_token := identifier(&context)
        int[] children := []
        while not failed(context) and next_text(context) == "["
            dimension_start := context.position
            opening := take(&context)
            closing := symbol(&context, "]")
            dimension := node(&context, "dimension", [opening, closing], [], dimension_start)
            children = children.append(dimension)
        return node(&context, "parameter", [type_token, name_token], children, start)
    if kind == "initlist"
        return initializer(&context)
    return expression(&context)

int list_node(Parsing &context, string kind, string opening_text, string closing_text, bool trailing_allowed)
    start := context.position
    opening := symbol(&context, opening_text)
    tokens := [opening]
    int[] children := []
    int | none tail := none
    if not failed(context) and next_text(context) != closing_text
        first := list_element(&context, kind)
        children = children.append(first)
        while not failed(context) and next_text(context) == ","
            comma := take(&context)
            if trailing_allowed and next_text(context) == closing_text
                tail = comma
                break
            tokens = tokens.append(comma)
            child := list_element(&context, kind)
            children = children.append(child)
    closing := symbol(&context, closing_text)
    tokens = tokens.append(closing)
    return node(&context, kind, tokens, children, start, tail)

int initializer(Parsing &context)
    if next_text(context) == "{{"
        return list_node(&context, "initlist", "{{", "}}", true)
    return expression(&context)

int declaration(Parsing &context, bool semicolon)
    start := context.position
    type_token := read_type(&context)
    name_token := identifier(&context)
    return declaration_rest(&context, start, [type_token, name_token], semicolon)

int declaration_rest(Parsing &context, int start, const int[] original, bool semicolon)
    tokens := original
    int[] children := []
    while not failed(context) and next_text(context) == "["
        dimension_start := context.position
        opening := take(&context)
        int[] content := []
        if next_text(context) != "]"
            child := expression(&context)
            content = content.append(child)
        closing := symbol(&context, "]")
        dimension := node(&context, "dimension", [opening, closing], content, dimension_start)
        children = children.append(dimension)
    if not failed(context) and next_text(context) == "="
        assignment := take(&context)
        tokens = tokens.append(assignment)
        value := initializer(&context)
        children = children.append(value)
    if semicolon
        ending := symbol(&context, ";")
        tokens = tokens.append(ending)
    return node(&context, "decl", tokens, children, start)

int block(Parsing &context)
    start := context.position
    opening := symbol(&context, "{{")
    int[] statements := []
    while not failed(context) and next_text(context) != "}}" and peek(context).kind != "end"
        child := statement(&context)
        statements = statements.append(child)
    closing := symbol(&context, "}}")
    return node(&context, "block", [opening, closing], statements, start)

int simple(Parsing &context)
    start := context.position
    left := expression(&context)
    if not failed(context) and lexer.has(["=", "+=", "-=", "*=", "/=", "%="], next_text(context))
        operator_token := take(&context)
        right := expression(&context)
        return node(&context, "assign", [operator_token], [left, right], start)
    return node(&context, "exprstmt", [], [left], start)

int statement(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    start := context.position
    kind := next_text(context)
    if kind == "{{"
        return block(&context)
    if is_type(kind)
        return declaration(&context, true)
    if kind == "if" or kind == "while"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := symbol(&context, "(")
        condition := expression(&context)
        closing := symbol(&context, ")")
        body := statement(&context)
        tokens := [keyword, opening, closing]
        children := [condition, body]
        if not failed(context) and kind == "if" and next_text(context) == "else"
            alternative := take(&context)
            tokens = tokens.append(alternative)
            other := statement(&context)
            children = children.append(other)
        return node(&context, kind, tokens, children, start)
    if kind == "for"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := symbol(&context, "(")
        initial := if next_text(context) == ";" then empty_node(&context) elif is_type(next_text(context)) then declaration(&context, false) else simple(&context)
        first := symbol(&context, ";")
        condition := if next_text(context) == ";" then empty_node(&context) else expression(&context)
        second := symbol(&context, ";")
        update := if next_text(context) == ")" then empty_node(&context) else simple(&context)
        closing := symbol(&context, ")")
        body := statement(&context)
        return node(&context, "for", [keyword, opening, first, second, closing], [initial, condition, update, body], start)
    if kind == "switch"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := symbol(&context, "(")
        condition := expression(&context)
        closing := symbol(&context, ")")
        left := symbol(&context, "{{")
        children := [condition]
        while not failed(context) and lexer.has(["case", "default"], next_text(context))
            clause_start := context.position
            clause_kind := next_text(context)
            label := take(&context)
            int[] content := []
            if clause_kind == "case"
                value := expression(&context)
                content = content.append(value)
            colon := symbol(&context, ":")
            while not failed(context) and not lexer.has(["case", "default", "}}"], next_text(context)) and peek(context).kind != "end"
                child := statement(&context)
                content = content.append(child)
            clause := node(&context, clause_kind, [label, colon], content, clause_start)
            children = children.append(clause)
        right := symbol(&context, "}}")
        return node(&context, "switch", [keyword, opening, closing, left, right], children, start)
    if kind == "return"
        keyword := take(&context)
        int[] children := []
        if next_text(context) != ";"
            value := expression(&context)
            children = children.append(value)
        ending := symbol(&context, ";")
        return node(&context, "return", [keyword, ending], children, start)
    if kind == "break" or kind == "continue"
        keyword := take(&context)
        ending := symbol(&context, ";")
        return node(&context, kind, [keyword, ending], [], start)
    value := simple(&context)
    ending := symbol(&context, ";")
    return node(&context, "statement", [ending], [value], start)

int primary(Parsing &context)
    start := context.position
    token := peek(context)
    if lexer.has(["identifier", "number", "string"], token.kind) or lexer.has(["true", "false"], token.text)
        atom_token := take(&context)
        return node(&context, "atom", [atom_token], [], start)
    if token.text == "("
        opening := take(&context)
        child := expression(&context)
        closing := symbol(&context, ")")
        return node(&context, "paren", [opening, closing], [child], start)
    ignored := failure(&context, "expression")
    return -1

int unary(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    start := context.position
    if next_text(context) == "-" or next_text(context) == "!"
        operator_token := take(&context)
        child := unary(&context)
        return node(&context, "unary", [operator_token], [child], start)
    target := primary(&context)
    while not failed(context)
        following := next_text(context)
        if following == "("
            arguments := list_node(&context, "args", "(", ")", false)
            target = node(&context, "call", [], [target, arguments], start)
        elif following == "["
            opening := take(&context)
            value := expression(&context)
            closing := symbol(&context, "]")
            target = node(&context, "index", [opening, closing], [target, value], start)
        elif following == "."
            dot := take(&context)
            name := identifier(&context)
            target = node(&context, "member", [dot, name], [target], start)
        else
            return target
    return -1

int binary(Parsing &context, int priority)
    start := context.position
    left := if priority == 6 then unary(&context) else binary(&context, priority + 1)
    while not failed(context) and precedence(next_text(context)) == priority
        operator_token := take(&context)
        right := if priority == 6 then unary(&context) else binary(&context, priority + 1)
        left = node(&context, "binary", [operator_token], [left, right], start)
    return if failed(context) then -1 else left

int expression(Parsing &context)
    start := context.position
    condition := binary(&context, 1)
    if not failed(context) and next_text(context) == "?"
        question := take(&context)
        yes := expression(&context)
        colon := symbol(&context, ":")
        no := expression(&context)
        return node(&context, "conditional", [question, colon], [condition, yes, no], start)
    return if failed(context) then -1 else condition

int item(Parsing &context)
    start := context.position
    type_token := read_type(&context)
    name_token := identifier(&context)
    if not failed(context) and next_text(context) == "("
        parameters := list_node(&context, "params", "(", ")", false)
        body := block(&context)
        return node(&context, "function", [type_token, name_token], [parameters, body], start)
    return declaration_rest(&context, start, [type_token, name_token], true)

Program | lexer.Problem parse(const lexer.Token[] tokens)
    context := Parsing(tokens)
    int[] items := []
    while not failed(context) and peek(context).kind != "end"
        child := item(&context)
        if not failed(context)
            items = items.append(child)
    match context.problem
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            return Program(context.nodes, items)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import doc = "./doc_builder.qui"

class Command(int indent, bool flat, int document)
class Printed(string[] lines, map<int, string> modes)
class Output(string[] lines := [], current := "", string[] pending := [])

bool fits(const doc.Store store, int width, const Command first, const Command[] stack)
    if width < 0
        return false
    remaining := width
    check := stack.append(first)
    while #check != 0
        command := check[-1]
        check = check[0:<int(#check) - 1]
        doc.Document document := store.items[command.document]
        if document.kind == "text"
            remaining -= int(#document.value)
        elif document.kind == "if_break"
            remaining -= int(#(if command.flat then document.flat_value else document.value))
        elif document.kind == "line"
            if not command.flat
                return true
            remaining -= 1
        elif document.kind == "softline"
            if not command.flat
                return true
        elif document.kind == "hardline"
            return true
        elif document.kind == "concat"
            backwards := document.children[::-1]
            for child := backwards[]
                check = check.append(Command(command.indent, command.flat, child))
        elif document.kind == "group"
            check = check.append(Command(command.indent, if doc.forced(store, command.document) then false else command.flat, document.children[0]))
        elif document.kind == "nest" or document.kind == "align"
            check = check.append(Command(command.indent, command.flat, document.children[0]))
        if remaining < 0
            return false
    return true

void finalize(Output &output, int width, int column)
    line := lexer.trim_end(output.current)
    if #output.pending > 0
        comment := output.pending.join(" ")
        if column > 0 and int(#line) < column - 1 and column - 1 + int(#comment) <= width
            line += lexer.repeat(" ", column - 1 - int(#line))
        else
            line += " "
        line += comment
        output.pending = []
    output.lines = output.lines.append(line)

Printed render(const doc.Store store, int root, int width, int column)
    stack := [Command(0, false, root)]
    output := Output()
    map<int, string> modes
    current_column := 0
    while #stack != 0
        command := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        doc.Document document := store.items[command.document]
        if document.kind == "text" or document.kind == "if_break"
            value := if document.kind == "text" or not command.flat then document.value else document.flat_value
            output.current += value
            current_column += int(#value)
        elif lexer.has(["line", "softline", "hardline"], document.kind)
            if document.kind == "hardline" or not command.flat
                finalize(&output, width, column)
                output.current = lexer.repeat(" ", command.indent)
                current_column = command.indent
            elif document.kind == "line"
                output.current += " "
                current_column += 1
        elif document.kind == "concat"
            backwards := document.children[::-1]
            for child := backwards[]
                stack = stack.append(Command(command.indent, command.flat, child))
        elif document.kind == "nest"
            stack = stack.append(Command(command.indent + document.amount, command.flat, document.children[0]))
        elif document.kind == "align"
            stack = stack.append(Command(current_column, command.flat, document.children[0]))
        elif document.kind == "suffix"
            output.pending = output.pending.append(document.value)
        elif document.kind == "group"
            mode := "flat"
            if not command.flat
                if doc.forced(store, command.document)
                    mode = "forced"
                elif not fits(store, width - current_column, Command(command.indent, true, document.children[0]), stack)
                    mode = "break"
            .modes.set(command.document, mode)
            stack = stack.append(Command(command.indent, mode == "flat", document.children[0]))
    finalize(&output, width, column)
    return Printed(output.lines, modes)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import doc = "./doc_builder.qui"

void tree(const doc.Store store, int index, int depth, const map<int, string> modes, string[] &output)
    doc.Document document := store.items[index]
    prefix := lexer.repeat(" ", depth * 2)
    if document.kind == "concat"
        for child := document.children[]
            tree(store, child, depth, modes, &output)
    elif document.kind == "text" or document.kind == "suffix"
        output = output.append(prefix + "{document.kind} {DQ}{document.value}{DQ}")
    elif document.kind == "if_break"
        output = output.append(prefix + "if_break {DQ}{document.value}{DQ} {DQ}{document.flat_value}{DQ}")
    elif document.kind == "group"
        match modes.get(index)
            string mode
                output = output.append(prefix + "group {mode}")
            none
                output = output.append(prefix + "group flat")
        tree(store, document.children[0], depth + 1, modes, &output)
    elif document.kind == "nest"
        output = output.append(prefix + "nest {document.amount}")
        tree(store, document.children[0], depth + 1, modes, &output)
    elif document.kind == "align"
        output = output.append(prefix + "align")
        tree(store, document.children[0], depth + 1, modes, &output)
    else
        output = output.append(prefix + document.kind)

string[] diff(const string[] original, const string[] formatted)
    rows := int(#original)
    columns := int(#formatted)
    int[][] lcs := array(nat(rows + 1), fill = array(nat(columns + 1), fill = 0))
    row := rows - 1
    while row >= 0
        column := columns - 1
        while column >= 0
            lcs[row][column] = if original[row] == formatted[column] then lcs[row + 1][column + 1] + 1 else lexer.maximum(lcs[row + 1][column], lcs[row][column + 1])
            column -= 1
        row -= 1
    first := 0
    second := 0
    deleted := 0
    inserted := 0
    string[][] hunks := []
    while first < rows or second < columns
        if first < rows and second < columns and original[first] == formatted[second]
            first += 1
            second += 1
            continue
        first_start := first
        second_start := second
        deletes := 0
        inserts := 0
        string[] operations := []
        while first < rows or second < columns
            if first < rows and second < columns and original[first] == formatted[second]
                break
            if second == columns or (first < rows and lcs[first + 1][second] >= lcs[first][second + 1])
                operations = operations.append("-" + original[first])
                first += 1
                deletes += 1
            else
                operations = operations.append("+" + formatted[second])
                second += 1
                inserts += 1
        deleted += deletes
        inserted += inserts
        first_number := if deletes > 0 then first_start + 1 else first_start
        second_number := if inserts > 0 then second_start + 1 else second_start
        hunk := ["@@ -{first_number},{deletes} +{second_number},{inserts} @@"]
        hunks = hunks.append(hunk.concat(operations))
    result := ["hunks={#hunks} deleted={deleted} inserted={inserted}"]
    for hunk := hunks[]
        result = result.concat(hunk)
    return result
